item.title: Programming intramolecular charge transfer in NDI–pyrene paracyclophanes through distance and linker design
item.description:
Authors: Camila Negrete-Vergara, Vladislav Slama, Elnaz Zyaee, Hans-Martin Frey, Silvio Decurtins, Thomas Feurer, Ursula Röthlisberger, Shi-Xia Liu

The molecular geometry controls the through-space charge transfer (TSCT) by adjusting the distance between chromophores and the overlap of their orbitals. Shorter distances between the NDI and pyrene enable rapid CT and efficient exciplex formation.

DOI: 10.1039/d6tc02775j
